delivery.question: How long does delivery take?
delivery.answer_html: We deliver to your door within 3 business days. The shipping cost is shown in the cart and at checkout, before you pay.

returns.question: Can I return an item?
returns.answer_html: Yes, you can return items within 45 days. The full terms are in our returns policy.

sizing.question: How do I choose the right size?
sizing.answer_html: Check the size guide on the product page and compare it with a shirt that fits you well. Kids' sizes go by age, from 5-6 to 13-14, and kids' items are sold as separate products.

payment.question: How can I pay?
payment.answer_html: You can pay by credit card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, on a secure checkout.

team_orders.question: Do you take team orders?
team_orders.answer_html: Sure. Amateur teams, schools and clubs can order together, in adult and kids' sizes. Send us the quantities and sizes on the team orders page or on WhatsApp, and we'll get back to you with a quote.

printing.question: Can you print names and numbers?
printing.answer_html: Not at the moment. Our shirts are sold without name, number or patch printing.

size_guide.heading: Find your size
size_guide.text: Sizes can vary between brands and cuts. Use the chart below and compare it with a shirt that fits you well.
size_guide.kids_note: The size is the child's age in years, and heights are approximate. If your child is between two sizes, choose the larger one.

measure.heading: How to measure
measure.intro: Use a soft tape measure, or measure a shirt that fits you well, and compare the results with the size chart on the product page.

chest.title: Chest
chest.text: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, under your arms, keeping the tape level.

length.title: Length
length.text: Measure from the highest point of the shoulder, next to the collar, straight down to the hem.

compare.title: Compare with a shirt that fits
compare.text: Lay the shirt flat. Measure straight across from armpit to armpit and double it, then measure the length. Compare with the size chart on the product page.
